transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started with our mediation-readiness huddle. As we all know, the former executive is demanding $425,000, mediation is next week, and our objective is a signed settlement with a full release of employment-related claims and a clean final separation. I have authority to approve the final resolution package, but I want to hear from both of you before I settle on terms and the authorized amount. Let's start with input from coverage counsel — what are you seeing on your end? And then I'd like to hear from our client liaison as well. After that round, I'll make a decision on the package framework and note any open items that need external follow-up as action items.
